description: Image and action updates as reviewable PRs. Merging to main is the deploy
trigger: Dockhand's git sync redeploys the changed stack. Dockhand's own
image auto-update stays OFF so nothing bypasses review.
minimumReleaseAge: hijacked or broken releases are usually caught and
yanked within days, so nothing younger than 5 days is proposed.
Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (a moved tag can't inject code); Renovate bumps SHA and version comment together.

packageRules.description: linuxserver tags: <version>[.<build>]-ls<rebuild>, optionally v-prefixed. Their weekly -ls rebuilds are grouped into one PR.
linuxserver Jellyfin: <major>.<minor>ubu<ubuntu>-ls<rebuild>. The Ubuntu base is a compatibility suffix, so a base-image jump needs a manual bump.
linuxserver restarted Sonarr's -ls counter (ls5 is newer than ls329), so ignore the rebuild number and only follow real Sonarr releases.
Group linuxserver patch/rebuild updates into one weekly PR.
Bookshelf: hardcover-v<readarr version>.<build>. Keep the hardcover- (Hardcover metadata) build.
Immich server and ML must move together.
Immich's Postgres tag is dictated by Immich's release notes, not by its own versioning.
Database majors change the on-disk format (dump/restore or pg_upgrade): stay on the current major and do those by hand.
MariaDB: stay on the 11.8 LTS line.
One PR for the Tailscale sidecar image across every stack.
Frigate minors (0.18 -> 0.19) rename config keys and migrate the DB one way: keep them in their own PR, apart from patches, with a reminder. The LXC deploys on merge (deploy-frigate.sh).

prBodyNotes: **Frigate minor release.** Merging deploys it to the LXC within the hour and migrates `frigate.db` one way. Read the release notes from the running version up to this one and add any `config/config.yml` changes to this PR first (see the Frigate README, "Updating").

packageRules.description: Our own image, built by its repo's CI; not tracked here.
nginx odd minors are mainline; stay on the stable (even) line.

customManagers.description: Quarto version in the docs-site workflow.
